messages:
Alex: Hi @Sam (Auditor) - dropping the artifact bundle for the RBAC & KMS questions. Short summary: key rotation completed 2026-03-18T01:00Z, captured CloudTrail events and rolebinding diffs.
Maria: Can you point to the exact CloudTrail event IDs the auditor asked for? They want envelope-key usage + policy change history.
Ken: Included in the bundle. Example events in cloudtrail/kms_calls.json: eventID c3f1a2b4-2026-03-18T02:22:11Z (Encrypt), eventID d5e6f7a8-2026-03-18T01:05:03Z (UpdateKeyPolicy).
Alex: Commands used to build bundle:
```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit-bundles/2026-03-18/kms-rbac-mini-1768649999.tar.gz .
tar -xzvf kms-rbac-mini-1768649999.tar.gz
grep -E "Encrypt|Decrypt|UpdateKeyPolicy|ListGrants" cloudtrail/*.json | sed -n '1,120p'
```
Maria: RBAC change is PR infra#5123; snapshot file rbac-snapshots/2026-03-17_to_2026-03-19.diff is in the bundle. We constrained the inference-service serviceAccount rolebinding.
Sam (Auditor): Please confirm which KMS key ARN the inference service used in the incident window (2026-03-18 02:00-05:00 UTC) and the matching CloudTrail eventIDs.
Ken: The ARN in our logs: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789. Look in cloudtrail/kms_calls.json where Encrypt events reference that keyId. Example: eventID c3f1a2b4, eventTime 2026-03-18T02:22:11Z, requestParameters.keyId = "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789".
Alex: Rotation metadata is in rotation/rotation_metadata.csv and signed manifest rotation/rotation-manifest.sig (chain of custody). Rotation completed 2026-03-18T01:00:00Z.
ComplianceBot: Export job finished - s3://redwood-audit-bundles/2026-03-18/kms-rbac-mini-1768649999.tar.gz (expires in 7 days).
Sam (Auditor): Need retention proof: logs retention >= 1 year and the current retention policy used by our Splunk/S3 pipeline.
Maria: We forward logs to s3://redwood-logs-archive with lifecycle 395 days. See ingest/config-retention.txt in the bundle and lifecycle.json in the archive folder. Also included splunk-export-2026-03-18.tgz for the window.
Ken: For RBAC provenance we added before/after YAMLs and the infra repo commit abcdef12345 that introduced the rolebinding. PR review link is included.
Alex: Auditor also wants proof there were no active decrypt grants to external principals during rotation. We ran ListGrants and included kms/grants-2026-03-18.json; no external granteeIds found.
Sam (Auditor): Also need key policy diff showing who had PutKeyPolicy before vs after rotation.
Maria: kms/key_policy_diff_2026-03-16_2026-03-19.json shows only a minor internal alias change for the security-admins principal; no external principals added, no new PutKeyPolicy grants.
Alex: Incident triage note: incidents/2026-03-18-token-reissue.md. Short: rolling restart re-encrypted some in-flight tokens with new key; no anomalous outbound connections in VPC flow logs. Outbound logs included.
Ken: Added signed oncall signoff incidents/signoffs/oncall-samuel-2026-03-19.sig confirming no anomalous principals.
Sam (Auditor): This looks good. Please enumerate the CloudTrail eventIDs for the envelope encrypt/decrypt events in a follow-up so I can map them to objects.
Maria: We can also produce a redacted minimal export (events + policy diffs + grant lists) if you prefer less payload.
Alex: Action items: 1) I will paste eventID list in a follow-up message, 2) produce redacted sample envelope metadata, 3) link retention policy in compliance playbook.
Sam (Auditor): Thanks all, I will review and come back with any remaining gaps by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
